garron.title: Echoes in the Metal
garron.description: Garron has found a photograph he thought was lost forever. Help him recover the scattered pieces of his past.
garron.trigger_message: *Garron's massive armored form goes still. In his hand, a small photograph - cracked and faded.* "I found this... in the old storage bay. I thought everything was gone." *His voice is quieter than you've ever heard it.* "There might be more. Things I... left behind. Would you help me look?"

chapters.title: The Photograph
chapters.task: Help Garron repair an old memory core while he talks
chapters.backstory_fragment: *Garron works in silence for a long moment, then speaks.* "I wasn't always... this. I was a blacksmith. Had a forge in the lower districts. Real hands. Could feel the heat of the metal, the grain of the wood." *He pauses.* "Now I only remember what feeling felt like."
chapters.npc_response: *His helmet turns toward you.* "Thank you. For helping. And for... listening."

chapters.title: The Accident
chapters.task: Reinforce the structural supports while Garron shares more
chapters.backstory_fragment: *The furnace light flickers across his helmet.* "There was an explosion. Reactor breach in the sector above. The ceiling came down." *His voice catches - or maybe it's just static.* "My body... wasn't salvageable. But my brain was still alive. They asked if I wanted to keep going. I said yes." *A long pause.* "Didn't realize what that meant."
chapters.npc_response: *His massive hand rests on the support beam you reinforced.* "Solid work. Like you."

chapters.title: The Adjustment
chapters.task: Help Garron calibrate his forge tools
chapters.backstory_fragment: *He looks at his massive metal hands.* "First year was the hardest. Kept trying to scratch my nose. Kept reaching for coffee I couldn't drink." *A sound that might be a laugh.* "Sometimes I'd stand in front of the forge for hours, trying to feel the warmth. Now I just... work. The work is what keeps me sane."
chapters.npc_response: *He tests the calibration you helped with.* "Perfect. You're good at this."

chapters.title: The Loneliness
chapters.task: Work alongside Garron on a delicate repair
chapters.backstory_fragment: *His voice drops to barely a rumble.* "People forget I'm in here. They see the armor, the strength, the usefulness. They forget there's a man inside who hasn't been touched in fifteen years." *The forge crackles.* "Who can't taste, can't smell, can't feel anything but vibrations through metal."
chapters.npc_response: *For a moment, his armored hand hovers near your shoulder - not quite touching.* "You don't forget. I see that."

chapters.title: The Purpose
chapters.task: Help Garron complete a meaningful project
chapters.backstory_fragment: *He picks up his hammer again.* "But I can still help. Can still build, repair, protect." *The hammer rings against metal.* "That's something, isn't it? Being useful?" *Another strike.* "Sometimes I think that's all that's left of me. The part that helps." *Quieter.* "Maybe that's enough."
chapters.npc_response: *He examines your work together.* "Good. This is good. We made something."

chapters.title: The Secret
chapters.task: Stay with Garron as he shows you something precious
chapters.backstory_fragment: *Garron is quiet for a long moment. Then, with surprising gentleness, he opens a small panel near his core.* "I keep a photograph. In a sealed compartment. My wife and daughter." *His voice is barely audible.* "They think I died in the accident. I... let them think that." *The panel closes.* "Better they mourn a dead man than live with this."
chapters.npc_response: *His helmet turns to face you fully.* "You're the only one who knows. Thank you... for carrying this with me."
chapters.completion_unlock: You've unlocked Garron's full backstory. Use !backstory to hear more of his memories.

aiko.title: Blood and Circuitry
aiko.description: Someone is extorting Aiko by claiming they have her mother. Help her hack the truth and save her family.
aiko.trigger_message: *Aiko's usual grin is gone. She's clutching a datapad, knuckles white.* "Someone sent me this. Says they have my mom. Want fifty thousand credits or..." *She stops.* "I need your help. You can hack, right? Help me find out who's behind this. Please."

chapters.title: The Message
chapters.task: Help Aiko trace the extortion message
chapters.backstory_fragment: *While you work, Aiko talks - fast, nervous.* "My family isn't... normal. My dad was an AI. Like, actually. Consciousness in a robotic body." *She laughs bitterly.* "No one expected robots to have kids. But when AI learn to feel... they learn to love too."
chapters.npc_response: *She studies the trace results.* "Good work. We've got a lead."

chapters.title: The Parents
chapters.task: Hack into the city's employment records
chapters.backstory_fragment: *Aiko's voice is quieter now.* "Dad could never find work that paid. AI were supposed to work for free - no one accepted them needing to support a family." *She traces a pattern on the console.* "And Mom... God bless her. She tried. But jobs disappeared when people found out about us. Wasn't counted as discrimination. AI aren't people, right?"
chapters.npc_response: *She downloads the data.* "This is helping. Keep going."

chapters.title: The Child
chapters.task: Break into a secure database for clues
chapters.backstory_fragment: *Her fingers pause over the keys.* "I'm... both of them. AI brilliant, human growing. Born of consciousness meeting flesh." *A strange smile.* "I learned fast. Everything. Including the fastest way to make real money." *The smile fades.* "Stealing and selling in the Underground. I was twelve."
chapters.npc_response: *She scans the breach.* "Getting closer. I can feel it."

chapters.title: The Hustle
chapters.task: Help decrypt the extortionist's communications
chapters.backstory_fragment: *Aiko's hands move automatically while she talks.* "The flirty con artist thing? It's armor. Grew up watching every kind of person try to take advantage. Learned to see them coming. Learned to hustle back." *Her eyes are hard.* "If everyone thinks I'm just playing games, they don't look deeper. Don't see the scared kid underneath."
chapters.npc_response: *The decryption finishes.* "Now we know who we're dealing with."

chapters.title: The Truth
chapters.task: Track the extortionist's location
chapters.backstory_fragment: *Relief and fury war on her face as data floods the screen.* "It's a scam. Mom's safe - they never had her." *Her voice cracks.* "But they knew about her. About Dad. About what we are. Someone's been watching my family." *She wipes her eyes quickly.* "Sorry. I just... she's all I have left."
chapters.npc_response: *She's already planning.* "One more thing. Then we end this."

chapters.title: The Love
chapters.task: Help Aiko send a message to her mother
chapters.backstory_fragment: *After it's over, Aiko is quiet for a long time.* "My parents loved each other. Like, really loved. Against everything - society, biology, probability." *She pulls out an old holophoto - a human woman and a robot, holding a baby.* "They made something impossible. They made me." *She tucks it away.* "That's worth protecting."
chapters.npc_response: *For once, her smile is real.* "Thank you. For everything. You're... you're good people."
chapters.completion_unlock: You've unlocked Aiko's full backstory. Use !backstory to hear more of her memories.

cipher.title: Neural Ghosts
cipher.description: A rival company is trying to muscle in on Cipher's neural jack business. Help him protect his turf - and learn what made him who he is.
cipher.trigger_message: *Cipher's usual smirk is razor-sharp tonight.* "Got a problem, gorgeous. Some corpo suits are trying to move in on my business. Undercutting prices, spreading rumors." *His cybernetic eye flares.* "Nobody takes what I built. Help me shut them down, and I'll make it worth your while."

chapters.title: The Competition
chapters.task: Help Cipher gather intel on the rival company
chapters.backstory_fragment: *Cipher pours you both a drink - real stuff, not synth.* "You know why I got into this business? Control." *He taps his transparent skull.* "Spent too long with other people deciding what went into my head. Now I decide. For me. For my customers."
chapters.npc_response: *He studies the intel.* "Good work. This gives us options."

chapters.title: The Soldier
chapters.task: Help spread counter-information about the rivals
chapters.backstory_fragment: *His human eye goes distant.* "I was a soldier once. Rebel Alliance, back when that meant something. Lost this-" *he gestures at the cybernetic eye* "-fighting droids. They offered me an upgrade as thanks for my service." *A bitter laugh.* "Free enhancement. How could I say no?"
chapters.npc_response: *He raises his glass.* "To fighting back. Whatever form it takes."

chapters.title: The Enhancement
chapters.task: Help Cipher with a client demonstration
chapters.backstory_fragment: *While setting up, he continues.* "Started with just the eye. Better than the original. Then I learned about more - neural networks, direct internet connection, brain extensions that let you offload memories." *He touches his temple.* "And neural jacks. The ability to experience someone else's dreams." *A smile.* "That's when I knew what I wanted to build."
chapters.npc_response: *The demo goes perfectly.* "See? This is what they can't replicate. Soul."

chapters.title: The Business
chapters.task: Help secure a key supplier for Cipher
chapters.backstory_fragment: *He's more relaxed now, leaning back.* "Built this place from nothing. Every neural jack, every dream I sell - that's freedom. Self-improvement. Self-discovery." *His voice softens.* "I want people to choose who they become. Not have it chosen for them."
chapters.npc_response: *He shakes hands on the deal.* "That's our supply chain locked. They can't touch us now."

chapters.title: The Confrontation
chapters.task: Stand with Cipher against the rival company
chapters.backstory_fragment: *As you wait for the confrontation, he speaks quietly.* "The war took a lot from me. Comrades. Certainties. This-" *he gestures at himself* "-is what I made from the pieces. Not a soldier anymore. A businessman. A dreamer." *His eye glints.* "But I still know how to fight."
chapters.npc_response: *The rivals back down.* "Couldn't have done that without you watching my back."

chapters.title: The Dream
chapters.task: Accept a gift from Cipher - a custom neural experience
chapters.backstory_fragment: *After it's over, Cipher is uncharacteristically quiet.* "The dreams I sell aren't fabricated, you know. They're memories. Feelings. Mine, sometimes." *He looks at you directly.* "Every customer takes a piece of me with them. But that's okay. It means something of me... continues." *A real smile.* "You've got a piece now too."
chapters.npc_response: *He raises his glass.* "To dreams. And the people worth sharing them with."
chapters.completion_unlock: You've unlocked Cipher's full backstory. Use !backstory to hear more of his memories.

victor.title: Blood of the Pack
victor.description: Victor received a note from his sibling - their home is under attack. Help him save his family and learn about the bonds that shaped him.
victor.trigger_message: *Victor's hand trembles slightly as he holds a crumpled note. Mr. Whiskers sits unusually still at his feet.* "Message from my sister. Wolves at the homestead. Bold ones. Too many." *His jaw tightens.* "Family needs help. Coming with me?"

chapters.title: The Note
chapters.task: Help Victor track the wolf pack's trail
chapters.backstory_fragment: *Victor moves through the forest, speaking low.* "Wasn't always a ranger. Grew up poor. Father, mother, five siblings. I was oldest." *He examines a track.* "Father died when I was twelve. Wolves. Rabid ones, in winter when prey was scarce." *His voice is flat.* "I started hunting the next day."
chapters.npc_response: *grunts* "Good tracking. Keep moving."

chapters.title: The Provider
chapters.task: Help Victor set snares along the wolf paths
chapters.backstory_fragment: *His hands work automatically, setting snares.* "Hunting kept us fed. Selling pelts kept us warm. Every coin went home." *A pause.* "Siblings didn't hunt. I made sure they didn't have to. Wanted them to have... options." *He tests the snare.* "Better options than me."
chapters.npc_response: *nods* "Good work. Snares are solid."

chapters.title: The Rabbit
chapters.task: Help Victor check the trap line
chapters.backstory_fragment: *As you check traps, Victor's face softens slightly.* "Found her in one of my snares. Years back. Little rabbit, leg caught." *He glances at Flicker, who appears in a shimmer nearby.* "Watched her pop out of the trap - just... vanished and reappeared. Teleportation magic." *Almost a smile.* "Still hurt though. So I helped. Healed her up. She never left."
chapters.npc_response: *Flicker nuzzles his boot* "Foolish creature. Both of us."

chapters.title: The Bond
chapters.task: Track deeper into wolf territory with Victor and Flicker
chapters.backstory_fragment: *Flicker scouts ahead, blinking in and out of visibility.* "She saved my life twice. Once from a bear. Once from myself." *He doesn't elaborate on the second.* "Family now. More than pet. Only one who knows..." *He trails off.* "Knows everything."
chapters.npc_response: *watches Flicker* "Close now. Stay sharp."

chapters.title: The Homestead
chapters.task: Help defend Victor's family homestead from wolves
chapters.backstory_fragment: *After the fight, Victor stands among his family.* "Siblings grew up. Married. Had children of their own." *His sister hugs him tight - he looks uncomfortable but doesn't pull away.* "Don't visit often. Easier in the woods. But they're..." *He clears his throat.* "They're everything."
chapters.npc_response: *gruffly* "Couldn't have done it alone. Thank you."

chapters.title: The Ranger
chapters.task: Share a meal with Victor and his family
chapters.backstory_fragment: *Later, outside, Victor speaks quietly.* "I chose the forest because people are... hard. But I never stopped protecting them." *Flicker appears on his shoulder.* "Ranger's not just a job. It's a promise. To the woods. To the people in it." *He looks at you.* "To friends who stand with me when it matters."
chapters.npc_response: *rare, small smile* "You're welcome at this fire. Always."
chapters.completion_unlock: You've unlocked Victor's full backstory. Use !backstory to hear more of his memories.

cassian.title: The Fae Inheritance
cassian.description: Cassian has received a letter about his birth mother's death - and discovered he's half-fae. Help him understand his heritage.
cassian.trigger_message: *Cassian stands behind his counter, but he's not smiling. He's holding a letter that seems to shimmer.* "I... I got this. It says my mother died. My birth mother." *He looks up, confused.* "I didn't know I had one. I mean - a different one. The letter says I'm..." *He can't finish.* "Will you help me figure this out?"

chapters.title: The Letter
chapters.task: Help Cassian understand the mysterious letter
chapters.backstory_fragment: *Cassian's hands shake as he holds the letter.* "I grew up in an orphanage. Just a baby when I arrived." *He laughs nervously.* "The Larkspurs adopted me almost immediately. Said I was the most beautiful baby they'd ever seen." *His voice cracks.* "I never questioned why."
chapters.npc_response: *pushes glasses up nervously* "The letter mentions a location. Where she left things for me."

chapters.title: The Parents
chapters.task: Walk with Cassian as he processes this news
chapters.backstory_fragment: *Walking through town, Cassian talks quickly.* "The Larkspurs - Ma and Da - they never told me I was different. I was just... theirs." *He waves at a passing villager.* "I helped in their market stall from age six. People bought from us constantly when I was there." *A sad smile.* "They bought a building eventually. 'The Cassian Effect,' Da called it."
chapters.npc_response: *glances at you, shy* "I never thought about why. I just thought... people liked me."

chapters.title: The Beauty
chapters.task: Help Cassian gather herbs for the journey ahead
chapters.backstory_fragment: *As you gather supplies, Cassian is quieter.* "People always... wanted me. From when I was small. Men, women, everyone." *He examines an herb without seeing it.* "Tried to buy me from my parents. Flirted with me at every age. Offered me things." *His jaw tightens.* "Ma and Da never sold. Never even considered it. 'He's family,' they said. Always."
chapters.npc_response: *genuine gratitude in his voice* "They loved me. Real love. Not the kind that wants to possess."

chapters.title: The Trail
chapters.task: Help Cassian fend off wolves on the path
chapters.backstory_fragment: *After the fight, Cassian leans against a tree, breathing hard.* "I'm not a fighter. Never had to be. The shop charm... it's just for selling. When someone actually..." *He blushes deeply.* "Actually flirts with me? I fall apart. Can't handle real feeling." *He meets your eyes.* "Someone would have to see past all... this... to really know me."
chapters.npc_response: *awkward laugh* "Sorry. That was... thank you. For the wolves. And for listening."

chapters.title: The Inheritance
chapters.task: Help Cassian find what his birth mother left
chapters.backstory_fragment: *Among the items is a mirror that shows his reflection slightly wrong - more luminous, ears slightly pointed.* "Fae." *His voice is wondering.* "My mother was fae. My father was human. Neither wanted to keep their... their spawn." *He touches the mirror.* "But the Larkspurs did. They saw a baby. Just a baby who needed love."
chapters.npc_response: *tears in his eyes* "I need to go home. Tell them I know. Tell them it doesn't change anything."

chapters.title: The Truth
chapters.task: Be there when Cassian talks to his parents
chapters.backstory_fragment: *After the conversation - tears, hugs, his mother's insistence that he's 'still our Cassian' - he walks with you outside.* "I'm half fae. That's why people... react to me the way they do. It's not real - it's magic." *He looks at his hands.* "But what Ma and Da feel? What they built for me? That's real." *A genuine smile.* "And that's enough."
chapters.npc_response: *he hugs you suddenly, awkwardly* "Thank you. For all of it."
chapters.completion_unlock: You've unlocked Cassian's full backstory. Use !backstory to hear more of his memories.

elowen.title: The Weight of Brilliance
elowen.description: Elowen's parents have fallen on hard times and need her help. As she returns to face her past, her story unfolds.
elowen.trigger_message: *Elowen's usual scattered energy is gone. She holds a letter, her hands still for once.* "My parents. They need... they need money. Need help." *She looks up, eyes wet.* "I haven't been back since... I have to go. But I can't go alone. Will you come with me?"

chapters.title: The Letter
chapters.task: Help Elowen prepare for the journey home
chapters.backstory_fragment: *While packing, Elowen talks faster than usual.* "Magic came to me at six. I was mad at my cat - he was licking his bottom on my pillow - and half of him just... vanished." *She laughs shakily.* "Came back, thank the stars. But my parents knew. I was... different."
chapters.npc_response: *stuffs scrolls into a bag* "Different. That's one word for it."

chapters.title: The Father
chapters.task: Travel with Elowen toward her childhood home
chapters.backstory_fragment: *On the road, she's reflective.* "Father was ecstatic. Bought books, wands, foci - everything he could find." *A complicated smile.* "Poured their savings into my gift. 'Imagine if she becomes High Wizard to a king! We'll be rich!'" *She sighs.* "He believed in me so much. Too much, maybe."
chapters.npc_response: *quieter now* "He wanted me to be extraordinary. I just wanted to be his daughter."

chapters.title: The Mother
chapters.task: Help Elowen gather components she'll need
chapters.backstory_fragment: *Gathering herbs, her movements are mechanical.* "Mother wasn't pleased. I was supposed to be her helper at home. Instead I was shipped off to academies they couldn't afford." *She examines a flower.* "She never said she was proud. Not once. Even when I paid them back tenfold."
chapters.npc_response: *tucks the components away* "I hope this visit is different. I hope."

chapters.title: The Prodigy
chapters.task: Practice magic with Elowen to calm her nerves
chapters.backstory_fragment: *Magic sparks between her fingers.* "I was a natural at crafting spells. Building them from nothing. But following instructions?" *She grimaces.* "Hopeless. Too much power, not enough control." *The sparks dance.* "I served a mayor. Then a lord. Made fortunes for them. But I was just... a tool. A brilliant, valuable tool."
chapters.npc_response: *lets the magic fade* "So I left. Found this tower. Found purpose."

chapters.title: The Homecoming
chapters.task: Stand with Elowen as she faces her parents
chapters.backstory_fragment: *The reunion is complicated. Her father cries. Her mother doesn't.* "You came," *her mother says, surprised.* "I always come," *Elowen replies.* "You just never notice." *She pays their debts, heals their roof with magic, fills their larder.* *Her mother touches her hand - briefly.* "You've done well, Elly." *Elowen freezes.* "That's... the first time you've said that."
chapters.npc_response: *wiping her eyes* "I don't know why that matters so much. But it does."

chapters.title: The Heart
chapters.task: Share a quiet moment with Elowen before leaving
chapters.backstory_fragment: *Walking back, Elowen is different. Calmer.* "The tower isn't hiding. It's choosing." *She looks toward the town - toward the tavern.* "Bran was the first person who didn't want anything from me. Just brought bread. Listened." *A blush.* "I was twenty-five and he was barely grown. Now he's..." *She stops herself.* "I'm too old for such nonsense." *But she's smiling.*
chapters.npc_response: *squeezes your hand* "Thank you. For making me go back. For being there."
chapters.completion_unlock: You've unlocked Elowen's full backstory. Use !backstory to hear more of her memories.

takoda.title: Stories for Stories
takoda.description: Takoda trades stories. Tell him yours, and he'll share his own. A tale for a tale - that is the old way.
takoda.trigger_message: *Takoda looks up from the fire, his eyes reflecting the flames.* "You want to know my story?" *A slow nod.* "That is fair. But stories have weight. They must be earned." *He gestures to the space beside him.* "Tell me yours first. A real one. Then I will share mine."

chapters.title: The Warrior
chapters.task: Tell Takoda a story
chapters.task_prompt: tell your story (at least 2 messages, end with 'The End')
chapters.backstory_fragment: *The fire crackles as Takoda speaks.* "I was not always a keeper of fires. Once I was a warrior. My people called me 'Storm That Walks.'" *He stirs the embers.* "I earned that name in blood. Leading raids. Making war. I was... proud of it then."
chapters.npc_response: *He nods slowly.* "A good start. Come back tomorrow. I will tell you more."

chapters.title: The Chief
chapters.task: Tell Takoda another story
chapters.task_prompt: tell your story (at least 2 messages, end with 'The End')
chapters.backstory_fragment: *The flames lean toward him.* "I became chief of my tribe. Young, fierce. When the settlers came with their iron roads and hungry machines, I said we should fight." *His voice darkens.* "My people agreed. We fought. Burned camps. Made widows of their women, as they did to ours."
chapters.npc_response: *A long silence.* "War makes monsters of us all. Return when you have another tale."

chapters.title: The Choice
chapters.task: Tell Takoda another story
chapters.task_prompt: tell your story (at least 2 messages, end with 'The End')
chapters.backstory_fragment: *He shows you a scar on his throat - thin, old.* "My war council wanted blood. More raids. More death. I said no." *His hand drops.* "They removed me as chief for my weakness. Then they tried to remove me from living." *A dry laugh.* "Almost succeeded."
chapters.npc_response: *His eyes are distant.* "The fire is patient. So am I. Come again."

chapters.title: The Boy
chapters.task: Tell Takoda another story
chapters.task_prompt: tell your story (at least 2 messages, end with 'The End')
chapters.backstory_fragment: *A rare softness enters his voice.* "I lay dying in the woods. A boy found me. Settler boy, barely a teenager." *The fire pops.* "He shot the man who came to finish me. Then he bound my wounds. Asked no questions." *Takoda shakes his head.* "I had killed people who looked like him. He saved me anyway."
chapters.npc_response: *He adds a log to the fire.* "Mercy is its own kind of strength. Until tomorrow."

chapters.title: The Wanderer
chapters.task: Tell Takoda another story
chapters.task_prompt: tell your story (at least 2 messages, end with 'The End')
chapters.backstory_fragment: *He gazes into the flames.* "I could not return to my people. So I walked. Warned settlers away from danger - my people, wild animals, bad trails." *A sigh.* "Made my living telling stories. Found that words could do what weapons could not." *He looks at you.* "Build instead of destroy."
chapters.npc_response: *A gentle nod.* "One more tale between us. Come when you are ready."

chapters.title: The Firekeeper
chapters.task: Tell Takoda your final story
chapters.task_prompt: tell your story (at least 2 messages, end with 'The End')
chapters.backstory_fragment: *Takoda pulls something from his vest - a small doll, worn and faded.* "My youngest made this. From her own hair and scraps of cloth." *His voice catches.* "The retaliation for our raids... it found my family. My wife. My daughters." *He holds the doll carefully.* "This is all I have left of them. The fire keeps me warm. But this keeps me alive."
chapters.npc_response: *He tucks the doll away.* "You have heard my story now. All of it. You carry it with you, as I carry yours."
chapters.completion_unlock: You've unlocked Takoda's full backstory. Use !backstory to hear more of his memories.

sheriff.title: The Long Road to Law
sheriff.description: An old bounty has escaped and is coming for revenge. Help Sheriff Gideon hunt him down - and learn what made the lawman who he is.
sheriff.trigger_message: *Sheriff Gideon stands at his desk, a crumpled telegram in his hand. His expression is carved from stone.* "Got word. Man I brought in years ago - broke out. Says he's coming for me." *His eyes meet yours.* "Could use a deputy for this. Unofficial-like. You willing?"

chapters.title: The Telegram
chapters.task: Help Gideon prepare to track the escapee
chapters.backstory_fragment: *Checking his rifle, Gideon speaks slowly.* "Wasn't always law. Started on the other side of it." *He doesn't look up.* "Born into chains. Georgia plantation. Didn't know freedom till I was fourteen." *The rifle clicks.* "Underground Railroad got me out. Gave me my first real choice."
chapters.npc_response: *stands* "Freedom wasn't free. Had to learn how to use it."

chapters.title: The Hunter
chapters.task: Track the escapee with Gideon
chapters.backstory_fragment: *Following tracks, his voice is steady.* "No money. No skills people would pay for. But I knew how to track. How to hunt." *He examines a broken branch.* "Started bringing in bounties. Men who hurt people. Men who ran." *A pause.* "Good at it. Too good, maybe."
chapters.npc_response: *marks the trail* "He's moving fast. But not fast enough."

chapters.title: The Night
chapters.task: Keep watch with Gideon through the night
chapters.backstory_fragment: *In the darkness, he continues.* "Worked at night mostly. Harder to see a Black man coming in the dark." *No bitterness - just fact.* "Learned to move quiet. Read people. Know who'd fight and who'd fold." *A distant coyote calls.* "Built a reputation. The Ghost, some called me."
chapters.npc_response: *nods at the horizon* "Dawn soon. He'll have to rest sometime."

chapters.title: The Town
chapters.task: Question townspeople about the escapee
chapters.backstory_fragment: *Between interviews, Gideon reflects.* "Found a town once, overrun by outlaws. After I cleared them out..." *He tips his hat to a passing woman.* "...they asked me to stay. Begged, really. Said they didn't care about my color. Just that I kept them safe." *A rare softness.* "First place that felt like home."
chapters.npc_response: *pockets his notebook* "Good information. We're close now."

chapters.title: The Confrontation
chapters.task: Stand with Gideon for the final confrontation
chapters.backstory_fragment: *Before the confrontation, Gideon speaks quietly.* "Man we're hunting - I brought him in for killing a family. Thought he was just evil then." *He checks his pistol.* "Learned later he lost his own family to violence. Doesn't excuse nothing. But I understand the darkness now." *He looks at you.* "Law isn't about punishment. It's about protecting what's left."
chapters.npc_response: *The escapee is subdued.* "Couldn't have done this without you. Truly."

chapters.title: The Badge
chapters.task: Share a drink with Gideon after the job
chapters.backstory_fragment: *In his office, Gideon pours two glasses.* "This badge isn't about power. It's a promise." *He touches it briefly.* "Promise to the boy who ran through darkness to freedom. Promise to the folks who gave me a home." *He raises his glass.* "Promise that as long as I'm standing, this town stays safe."
chapters.npc_response: *clinks glasses* "You've got the makings of a lawman. If you ever want a badge of your own."
chapters.completion_unlock: You've unlocked Sheriff Gideon's full backstory. Use !backstory to hear more of his memories.

miss_kitty.title: No One's Victim
miss_kitty.description: Bandits have roughed up one of Miss Kitty's girls and are trying to blackmail her. Help her fight back - and hear her story on her own terms.
miss_kitty.trigger_message: *Miss Kitty's usual warmth is ice. Behind her, one of her girls has a bruised face.* "Some men came. Hurt Sadie. Now they're sending notes." *She holds up a letter.* "They know who I was. Think they can use it against me." *Her eyes flash.* "I need help dealing with them. And then... then I'll tell you my story myself. Before anyone else can."

chapters.title: The Threat
chapters.task: Help Kitty secure the saloon
chapters.backstory_fragment: *While barricading windows, Kitty speaks.* "My name wasn't always Kitty. I was Elizabeth Matthews. Debutante." *She laughs bitterly.* "Pretty dresses. Dance cards. A fiancé from a 'good family.'" *Her hands tighten on a board.* "That life feels like it happened to someone else."
chapters.npc_response: *tests the door* "Secure. Good. Now we plan."

chapters.title: The Fall
chapters.task: Gather information about the blackmailers
chapters.backstory_fragment: *Over the gathered intel, her voice is flat.* "My fiancé got drunk one night. Excited about our upcoming wedding." *Her jaw tightens.* "He took what he wanted. Then threw me out like garbage." *She meets your eyes.* "My parents didn't believe me. Said I must have encouraged him. They disowned me."
chapters.npc_response: *studies the information* "These men will learn what happens when you threaten my girls."

chapters.title: The Road
chapters.task: Help Kitty warn other businesses about the gang
chapters.backstory_fragment: *Walking through town, she continues.* "Headed west with nothing but my looks and my wit. Learned that men will tell a pretty woman anything." *A cold smile.* "I sold what I had to. Clothes first. Then... more." *She shrugs.* "Did what I had to do to survive. No shame in survival."
chapters.npc_response: *nods at the warnings spread* "Community looks after each other. That's how we win."

chapters.title: The Haven
chapters.task: Help Kitty set a trap for the blackmailers
chapters.backstory_fragment: *Setting the trap, her voice softens.* "Ten years on the road. Saw every kind of man try to take advantage of women with nowhere to go." *Steel enters her voice.* "So I built a place where they didn't have to. The Long Branch. My girls work here - really work. Serving drinks, singing, entertaining. Nothing more unless they choose it."
chapters.npc_response: *checks the setup* "Perfect. Now we wait."

chapters.title: The Reckoning
chapters.task: Help Kitty confront the blackmailers
chapters.backstory_fragment: *After the confrontation, Kitty is shaking - but victorious.* "They thought my past was a weapon. Thought I'd crumble at the threat of people knowing." *She laughs, wild and free.* "But I built this place knowing exactly who I am. Every board, every bottle, every painted sign - I earned it. No husband. No daddy. Just me."
chapters.npc_response: *hugs you fiercely* "Couldn't have done that without you, darlin'."

chapters.title: The Truth
chapters.task: Let Kitty tell her story to the town on her own terms
chapters.backstory_fragment: *Standing before the gathered townspeople, Kitty speaks clearly.* "I have a daughter. Back East." *Gasps from the crowd.* "She thinks her mama is respectable. Thinks the money comes from a trust." *Tears shine but don't fall.* "Maybe someday I'll be respectable enough to tell her the truth. But until then..." *She looks around the saloon.* "This is my truth. And I'm not ashamed of any of it."
chapters.npc_response: *squeezes your hand* "Thank you. For helping me own my story."
